chunks: And Ali عليه السلام saw no harm in cutting gray hair, but he disliked plucking it.

key_terms.الشَّيْبِ: gray hair or white hair of old age
key_terms.بَأْسًا: harm or objection; legal blameworthiness is negated here
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: Imam Ali عليه السلام, the reported source of the ruling
key_terms.يَكْرَهُ: he disliked; indicates reprehensibility rather than prohibition

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to cut gray hair, and is plucking it disliked in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam Ali عليه السلام considered cutting gray hair to be permissible, while regarding plucking it as disliked. It reflects guidance on personal grooming and etiquette within the broader teachings on cleanliness and beautification.
